name: governed-memory-plus-content-addressed-source-object
not_run_reason: Live preflight found no Docker/Podman, PostgreSQL toolchain, Go, Rust, MinIO, or mc; MinIO AGPL permission and PostgreSQL server provenance remain unresolved

candidate_dispositions.blocker: PostgreSQL server release/commit/license provenance not yet pinned

blockers: inspected community repository says no longer maintained
source build requires Go 1.24 or later
default API/console binding is not loopback-scoped
release update checks are a separate egress path
versioned DELETE may create only a delete marker

authority_invariants: only explicit approval creates a current projection
revocation removes current projection but preserves allowed audit history
same idempotency key plus same digest replays one identity
same idempotency key plus different digest fails closed
tenant scope is mandatory in every retrieval
object tags do not contain authority state
runtime_requirements: all listeners bind to 127.0.0.1 dedicated ports
first runtime attempt runs under OS-level public-network denial
MinIO release update checks are explicitly disabled
MinIO API and console addresses are explicitly loopback-bound and the console is disabled when unused
synthetic non-default MinIO credentials are supplied
all processes and listeners are stopped after the fixture
acceptance: proposals absent from current retrieval before approval
revoked and deleted memories absent from current retrieval
ten repeated exact queries have identical order and scores
export and fresh reload preserve object digests and retrieval order
failure reconciliation never exposes a partially committed current memory
public network and external business writes remain zero during runtime
human_decisions: MinIO AGPL permission for ephemeral fixture
